'''Patrick Chow''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Ottawa Grand Slam]] on 20 May 2000 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|HDADTJ duel]], according to Raphael Asselin's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d769">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-21-ottawa-gs-05-21-00d769/ ottawa-gs-05-21-00], DeckTech (Raphael "Assassin" Asselin, 21 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-21-ottawa-gs-05-21-00d769/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
